connector.name: Japan Seasons
connector.registryDescription: Live Japan seasonal travel MCP: sakura, autumn leaves, flowers, festivals, fruit farms, weather.
connector.summary: Hosted at seasons.kooexperience.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package japan-seasons-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the haomingkoo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
